title: The Shubin--Vakilian--Wolff Uncertainty Principle at Half Density
summary: Shubin, Vakilian, and Wolff proved a Fourier uncertainty principle for sets of sufficiently small local density at the reciprocal scale and asked whether every density below one is admissible. We answer this question negatively in dimension one by constructing sequences of pairs of $1/2$-density thin sets and unit vectors whose total position and Fourier mass outside these sets tends to zero.
